check: whether the three GameTest counts are used consistently in reader-facing documents
why: Having established that 118, 119 and 129 are all correct at different commits, the next question is whether the documents distinguish them or mix them so a reader cannot tell which is current.
finding: They are distinguished. Every occurrence of 119 sits in a historical frame.
examples: verification-report-20261007.md line 24 calls it the early figure, noting the 119 run once reported failure
line 47 records 'All 119 required tests passed' as what that run produced, with its 3h22m duration
line 61 shows the progression explicitly, 119 in the before column and 129 in the after column with full re-run pending
line 74 refers to the 119-test log as already lost to a later --rerun-tasks
acceptance.json line 112 places it under full-package with 'from a re-run after the baseline was invalidated'
the inventory file opens by saying the suite has not been run since the count changed from 119 to 129
the118FigureDoesNotAppear: No reader-facing document uses 118. It exists only in the goal text and the commit history, so it cannot mislead anyone reading the repository.
conclusion: A reader encountering 119 and 129 sees both labelled with their time, so neither is mistaken for the current count. The pending run is unambiguously the 129-test one.
